YUKIMOD_YUKI_STARTER_RELIC.title: Moonshadow Pendant
YUKIMOD_YUKI_STARTER_RELIC.flavor: She begins each fight by drawing one quiet blade into reach.
YUKIMOD_YUKI_STARTER_RELIC_PLUS.title: Moonshadow Pendant+
YUKIMOD_YUKI_STARTER_RELIC_PLUS.descript:
At the start of combat, [gold]Converge[/gold] 2.
Your [gold]Moonshadow[/gold] costs 1 less.
YUKIMOD_YUKI_STARTER_RELIC_PLUS.flavor: Once the rhythm settles in, the second blade is already waiting.
YUKIMOD_HEI_YUN_JIE_ZHI.title: Black Cloud Ring
YUKIMOD_HEI_YUN_JIE_ZHI.description: At the start of combat, enter [gold]Black Cloud[/gold].
YUKIMOD_HEI_YUN_JIE_ZHI.flavor: A thin ring that settles before the blade leaves its sheath.
YUKIMOD_LING_GAN_XIANG_LIAN.title: Inspiration Necklace
YUKIMOD_LING_GAN_XIANG_LIAN.description: Whenever [gold]Inspiration[/gold] triggers, deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
YUKIMOD_LING_GAN_XIANG_LIAN.flavor: A faint pulse follows every sudden idea.
YUKIMOD_YUE_YING_SHOU_HUAN.title: Moonshadow Bracelet
YUKIMOD_YUE_YING_SHOU_HUAN.description: At end of turn, if you have [gold]Moonshadow[/gold] in hand, gain 2 Block.
YUKIMOD_YUE_YING_SHOU_HUAN.flavor: It tightens the moment moonlight gathers in her palm.
YUKIMOD_LING_GAN_BING_XIE.title: Inspiration Ice Skates
YUKIMOD_LING_GAN_BING_XIE.description: At the start of combat, your [gold]Inspiration[/gold] cards in hand gain [gold]Inspiration[/gold].
YUKIMOD_LING_GAN_BING_XIE.flavor: The first step is always the sharpest.
YUKIMOD_HEI_YUN_DAO_QIAO.title: Black Cloud Sheath
YUKIMOD_HEI_YUN_DAO_QIAO.flavor: When the cloud settles, the blade answers with weight.
YUKIMOD_YUE_YING_SHU_DAI.title: Moonshadow Sash
YUKIMOD_YUE_YING_SHU_DAI.description: At end of turn, your [gold]Moonshadow[/gold] in hand gain +2 damage.
YUKIMOD_YUE_YING_SHU_DAI.flavor: It keeps the edge from cooling between strikes.
YUKIMOD_BING_XUE_SHOU_ZHUO.title: Ice Snow Bracelet
YUKIMOD_BING_XUE_SHOU_ZHUO.description: Each turn, randomly trigger [gold]Inspiration[/gold] on a card in your hand.
YUKIMOD_BING_XUE_SHOU_ZHUO.flavor: Cold focus reaches the hand before the blade.
